c189_preselected.metric: RQA ratio LAVG/RR on delay-embedded log-volume returns. LAVG = mean diagonal line length over qualifying diagonal lines (k>=1, l>=l_min, excluding LOI). RR = recurrence rate = sum of recurrence points / (M_pts*M_pts) (or over valid diagonals as pre-stated fail-closed; use standard RR = number of recurrent pairs / M_pts^2 on the full recurrence matrix). RATIO_LAVG_RR = LAVG / RR. m=2,tau=1,eps=0.5*std(r_window),W_RR=168,l_min=2. Fail-closed NaN if RR==0 or undefined/non-finite/degenerate, LAVG undefined/non-finite/degenerate, ratio non-finite. Trailing/causal only.
c189_preselected.note: Distinct from C125-C188; not used before (grep 0). LAM_OVER_DET was considered but collides with existing script(s); LAVG_OVER_RR selected as grep-zero fallback. Re-verify grep=0 non-self at C189 run time.
